Position Tools is a tool that allows you to see all the information relating to your GPS location.

Position Tools include:
- Altimeter
- Barometer
- Speedometer
- Thermometer
- Hygrometer
- Geographic coordinates
- Address where we are
- Accuracy of GPS

The background changes depending on the REAL WEATHER!

EFFECT ANIMATION:
- Cloud
- Snow
- Rain
- Fog
- Thunder

UNITS AVAILABLE: 
- Altimeter (meter - feet) 
- Speedometer (km/h - Mph)
- Thermometer (°C - °F)
- Barometer (hPa -bar- mmHg)

- Today Extension (in Notification Center)
